description:
Evaluate chart data and optional signal triggers over a specific range.

[Access: pay 0.05 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

params.description: Signal parameters; omitted values use registered defaults

chart_timeframe.description: Live chart timeframe; dataset mode uses its bundled timeframe

dataset_key.description: Bundled dataset key; replaces symbol and date range

end_date.description: Live-mode chart end timestamp; required unless dataset_key is provided

signals.description: Up to 20 registered signals to evaluate

start_date.description: Live-mode chart start timestamp; required unless dataset_key is provided

symbol.description: Live-mode asset symbol; required unless dataset_key is provided

name: evaluate_multiple_signals_series
